sections.shortTitle: Sindh Universities and Institutes Laws Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SINDH UNIVERSITIES AND INSTITUTES LAWS
SINDH UNIVERSITIES
AND INSTITUTES LAWS
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE V OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the certain laws relating to the Universities and other educational
Institutes in force in the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I 13th February, 2002]
No. S. LEGIS: 1(5)/2002, dated 13‑2‑2002.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh
Universities and Institutes Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

before the full stop, the words "or his nominee not below the rank of an
Additional Secretary" shall be inserted.
3. Amendment of sections 15
and 18 of Sindh Act XI of 1995.‑‑In the Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali
Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act, 1995‑‑
(o) in section 15, in subsection
